name: Emma
short_description: AI clinical assistant by mdhub that documents behavioral health sessions in real time, generating SOAP, DAP, BIRP, and progress notes automatically.
long_description: Emma is mdhub's AI clinical assistant purpose-built for behavioral health documentation. She listens to sessions in real time and automatically generates clinical notes in SOAP, DAP, BIRP, and progress note formats while accurately capturing diagnosis codes, presenting problems, and interventions. Part of mdhub's AI-native operating system for behavioral health, Emma has been used in over 3 million patient sessions, saving clinicians an estimated 500,000+ hours of administrative work. The platform is HIPAA compliant and SOC 2 Type II certified, with audio recordings never stored and data retention controlled by the clinic.
one_liner: AI scribe for behavioral health that documents sessions and generates compliant notes automatically.
best_for: Mental health clinicians spending excessive time on documentation
Psychiatrists and PMHNPs needing real-time note generation
Group practices wanting to standardize documentation across clinicians
Behavioral health organizations using mdhub's integrated platform
not_for: Practices requiring standalone EHR functionality without mdhub

compliance.notes: HIPAA compliant and SOC 2 Type II certified. End-to-end encryption. Audio recordings are not stored. Data is de-identified with retention controlled by the clinic.
